note: Titles are copied from file names in the band's archive (S43); the audio itself is not published. File dates are the file-system years and may reflect copying, not recording.

groups.title: Draft album sequence, 2010
groups.text: A 13-track folder of the album as sequenced in 2010, in this order: Audacity of Dope, Keep It Up, We Don't Care, Master of the Universe, Fade Out, Stay Up, I Feel Alive, Night of the Living Shred, Glow in the Dark, Tonight Never Ends, Dirty Dirty Mess, So Hooked, Eyes on Me. It differs from the released list: 'Stay Up' became 'Millennium Falkor (Stay Up)', and 'So Hooked' and 'Neverending Story' (which also has mixes) are not on the official Fearless list, which has 'A Closer Reference' instead.

groups.title: Album mix files, September to October 2010
groups.text: Mix revisions dated in the file names: Keep It Up (9-27-10), Glow In The Dark (9-28-10, plus an alternate chorus), I Feel Alive (9-28-10), Tonight Never Ends (9-30-10), Neverending Story (10-1-10, with and without breaks), So Hooked (10-2-10), Fade Out (10-5-10), Master Of The Universe (10-6-10).

groups.title: Demos and song ideas, 2008 to 2010
groups.text: Medicate Me; Never Full (vocals); Ready When You Are (music, two versions); Glow in the Dark (first cut with vocals); I Feel Alive (demo 1); Tonight Never Ends (demo 3); Keep It Up (demo); Nancy Dro (v2.4); Song 1 (mix 8 and mix 9); Nothing Without Me (idea and version 1); Tell Me Everything You Know (with and without vocal); Lets Do It 2; Synth Heavy Idea; a Coldplay and Chris Brown mash-up idea (unfinished).

groups.title: Other released and extra tracks
groups.text: All My Life (the Rockin' Romance compilation track); a 2010 holiday track '@Santas_Playlist'; 'To Catch A Snipe (Opening Night)' in the EP's high-quality folder; a 'Bonus Songs' archive for the EP (2010).

groups.title: A 2008 live rehearsal set
groups.text: A click-track set in the band's Oct 2008 tour folder: Duck Duck Grey Goose, Maps, Love Lockdown (a cover), Shoot For Teams, Tango, Talk Break, Theatrical Song, Do Not Disturb.
